title: Lantern Lodge / Hội Quán Ánh Đèn — three original table games
upstream_plan_hint: Use the actual checked-out Phase 1 state, never the ZIP snapshot

waves.title: Hải Đồ Sương Mù end-to-end + pilot
Cross-game acceptance, ops, Android + staging
waves.gate: Ba trò verified ở phạm vi nội bộ

modules.title: Lantern Lodge — world, game session và shared UX
modules.goal: Tạo một world và bộ công cụ ván đấu theo lượt, giữ RoomAuthority và safety hiện hữu.

modules.title: Sắc Đèn — color/action card game
modules.goal: Triển khai 64-card game với glow twist, luật deterministic, UX web/touch và acceptance.

modules.title: Mặt Nạ — bluff/challenge card game
modules.goal: Triển khai hidden card claim/challenge, không roulette/súng, giữ bí mật bài và luật timeout rõ.

modules.title: Hải Đồ Sương Mù — hidden-role route game
modules.goal: Triển khai role/goal bí mật, tile connectivity, clue, winner resolution, tests solvability.

modules.title: Cross-game QA, metrics, Android và staging playtest
modules.goal: Nghiệm thu privacy, authority, performance, operator controls và release decisions độc lập.

tasks.title: Khóa product scope, luật và content/IP constraints
deliverables: Freeze proposal rule v1 docs and original naming
acceptance: Đối chiếu M05/06/07/08/09/M13/Nxx hiện hữu; không tạo thêm identity/world room owner.
Ba rulebooks có ví dụ/phase/timeouts/target audience, mọi đổi luật có ADR.
Tên/graphics/audio khác biệt, không dùng asset hoặc tên Party Animals trong sản phẩm.

manual: Review product journey và rủi ro nội dung trước code.

tasks.rollback: Revert docs/ADR only; không chỉnh nguồn ngoài scope.

tasks.title: Hợp đồng GameSession và pure rules engine
acceptance: Mỗi mode nhận deterministic state+command+clock và trả nextState/effects, không import network/DB/React.
Phân tách public/own/spectator projection bằng allowlist và version; invalid commands không thay state.
Không thư viện world nào được import API repository trực tiếp; boundary guard bắt lỗi.

manual: API/client signatures được chốt từ implementation/tests, không chỉ từ plan.

tasks.rollback: Tắt module flag, trả contract về phiên bản cũ tương thích; không phá clients phân phối.

tasks.title: World scene, table lobby, consent và permissions
acceptance: Table join không tạo world membership thứ hai; room current policy kiểm trên mọi entry path.
Table cap 2–6/3–6/4–8 có race tests; một account chỉ ở một game active.
Default flags OFF; origin/provenance art; invite không tự ép join hoặc travel.

manual: Browser keyboard/mobile lobby empty/full/private flows.

tasks.rollback: Disable all Lodge/table flags, remove only new world/catalog registration, giữ users hiện hữu an toàn.

tasks.title: Encrypted durable game journal, idempotency và recovery
deliverables: Encrypted match state and unique receipts
Reconciliation after owner restart or truthful abort
acceptance: Một accepted command = một persisted stateVersion và result; same key never duplicates result.
Encrypted hands/roles/deck/target at rest; missing key fails closed; backups/key custody reviewed.
Restart/DB outage/owner-loss cleanup không tuyên bố phantom win, không giữ pending unfair secret.

manual: Use disposable DB and restore drills; no down migration on retained/prod DB.

tasks.rollback: Feature flags OFF; keep additive schema and stored outcomes; roll forward compatible code, not destructive DB down.

tasks.title: Shared match UI, recipient projections và reconnect
deliverables: Shared match shell and status UX
acceptance: Own hand/role only in per-account auth projection; spectator/public/metrics never contains secrets.
Lost ACK/duplicate/out-of-order event/update account/reconnect all converge on server current view.
DOM action controls support keyboard/touch/reduced motion; status never claims success before ACK.

manual: Inspect desktop/Android prototype screenshots at error/reconnect/timeout.

tasks.rollback: Unregister shell routes and flags; no destructive match state change.

tasks.title: Freeze 64-card deck, Glow và turn rules
acceptance: Màu/số/action/wild/PIVOT đều có cases positive+negative.
2-player REVERSE, final action, recycle draw pile, tie/timeout được xác định.
Reducer không có infinite turn hoặc âm Glow; no stacking trong v1.

manual: Playthrough giấy ít nhất 3 biến thể trước freeze.

tasks.rollback: Rule v1 chưa distribute: revert manifest; nếu đã live, giữ v1 active cho matches cũ.

tasks.title: Server reducer Sắc Đèn, receipts và authoritative timer
acceptance: Không thể đánh card không thuộc hand; old requestId replay không thêm action.
Server tôn trọng current identity/table/phase/deadline, không dùng client timer.
Draw + PLAY_DRAWN optional và effects apply đúng một lần, không double winner/XP.

manual: Check SQL and emitted own/public views against rules fixture.

tasks.rollback: Flags OFF and compatible reducer retained until old active matches settle.

tasks.title: UI đánh bài web/Android với icon hỗ trợ colorblind
deliverables: Hand/table layout and responsive card actions
Color modal, Glow indicator, turn prompt
acceptance: User có thể chọn/lấy/thả bài qua tap/keyboard, không chỉ drag.
Color luôn đi với chữ/glyph; disabled actions giải thích lý do.
Delay/reconnect không làm card biến mất trước authoritative ACK.

manual: Check one physical Android + desktop browser after available; no iPhone claim.

tasks.rollback: Route disabled per game flag; source unchanged for other modes.

tasks.title: Concurrency, security và một ván Sắc Đèn end-to-end
acceptance: 64-card invariant, 2-tab replay, two concurrent turns and timeout pass.
Spectator/admin/report path không lộ bài, all outcomes 1 winner or explicit ties.
No regression M06 room/seat, M08 safety, M09 travel, N05 reconnection.

manual: Inspect evidence frame/action counts/latency; report skipped checks.

tasks.rollback: Disable Sắc Đèn only and abort/recover active matches under explicit policy.

tasks.title: Pilot UX và cân bằng Sắc Đèn
deliverables: Rules/UX change proposal based on evidence
acceptance: Recorded feedback from multiple human testers, not only bot pass.
Mismatch between rule wording and UI fixed or blocked explicitly.
Any rule balance change increments rulesetVersion rather than mutating old matches.

manual: Small supervised human playtest.

tasks.rollback: Keep v1 flag OFF or rollback UI only; preserve game history.

tasks.title: Freeze face-down claim, challenge and six-round rules
deliverables: Challenge/trust deterministic examples and unit tests
acceptance: Exactly 1–2 owned cards per claim, 4-claim max/round, target symbol server-owned.
Correct/false challenges score exactly once, credibility bounded and no random violence.
Timeout default trust does not auto-submit an impostor claim; max rounds finite.

manual: Test comprehension of claim/challenge wording.

tasks.rollback: Freeze previous ruleset for active matches; do not reinterpret committed claims.

tasks.title: Server sealed claims and confidential reveal projections
acceptance: Unchallenged cards never leak, challenged reveal only last claim.
Two challengers/trust simultaneous -> one effective state transition.
No user may forge deck content, symbol or owner role, even using old client.

manual: Inspect redacted HTTP/socket/log data from actual test process.

tasks.rollback: Disable mode; retain encrypted matches until safe settlement/abort.

tasks.title: UI lựa chọn Tin/Lật và điểm Uy Tín
deliverables: Challenge modal with stakes and deadline
acceptance: Opponent hand/secret not in browser state, even hidden DOM/data attributes.
Tap/keyboard handles choice and 1–2 card confirmation.
Reveal animation mirrors committed transition only; reduced-motion substitute works.

manual: Desktop + physical Android viewport where available.

tasks.rollback: Disable UI mode flag, retain backend support for ongoing compatible matches.

tasks.title: Adversarial acceptance Mặt Nạ
acceptance: One challenge winner/loser, no leak of hidden cards or previous unchallenged claims.
Timeout, reconnect, account block, host disconnect and stale phase recovery are safe.
No extra punitive content or gambling progression introduced.

manual: Human review of message tone in deception game.

tasks.rollback: Mode OFF and documented rule-versioned cancellation path.

tasks.title: Pilot social bluff và diễn đạt luật
deliverables: Refined UX copy and risk policy
acceptance: Testers understand exactly whose cards are challenged and what is lost.
No harassment built into default quick-emote presets; report/block easy.
Changes to win condition versioned; data not fabricated as measured retention.

manual: Moderated 3–6 player prototype session and anonymized notes.

tasks.rollback: Keep mode in internal pilot / flag OFF if usability or safety issues remain.

tasks.title: Freeze 7×7 map, connector tiles, hidden factions và objective
deliverables: Role allocation policy and ruleset v1
acceptance: Phe Sương Mù 1 người khi 4–5, 2 khi 6–8; chỉ current player thấy role.
Three exits one true target; board geometry and enough solvable turns verified by generator/test.
No external party art or licensed board designs.

manual: Pilot paper puzzles; record whether map choices are understandable.

tasks.rollback: Remove invalid seeds/rules before launch, preserve old ruleset if matches already live.

tasks.title: Authoritative tile placement, compass và BFS settlement
deliverables: Path/rotation reducer with directed N/E/S/W checks
acceptance: Server alone computes connected route, tile legality and actual treasure goal.
Concurrent same-cell moves -> one accepted; stale second rejected; invalid moves never decrement hand.
Role/goal encrypted and never included in public delta until authorized settlement.

manual: Check one full 4-player and 8-player action trace.

tasks.rollback: Disable mode, retain compatible match reducer; no destructive ruleset migration.

tasks.title: UX bản đồ và thao tác xoay thẻ trên web/Android
deliverables: 7×7 responsive board, safe tile rotation UI
acceptance: Tap-to-select/rotate/confirm, keyboard equivalent; not drag-only.
Map reveals no secret true exit to crew/spectators even through alt text/test ids.
Glitches/reconnect maintain tile orientation and turn deadline server-authoritative.

manual: Physical Android zoom/pan performance and small-screen usability.

tasks.rollback: Mode OFF while preserving shared shell and other games.

tasks.title: Hidden-role anti-cheat, solvability và acceptance
deliverables: Full-match winner cases for both factions
acceptance: Generator cannot produce impossible start under defined constraints; document rejected seeds.
Neither public/spectator/admin stats nor browser secrets reveal target/other player role.
Both victory paths, abort conditions and tie policy stable with retries/owner loss.

manual: Inspect whether accessibility cues reveal roles by accident.

tasks.rollback: Disable new match starts; existing matches settle under v1 or truthful ABORT.

tasks.title: Pilot cân bằng phe ẩn và khả năng giải được
deliverables: Simulation reports with sample counts and seeds
acceptance: Report role win rate, stale/game length, invalid move frequencies by sample size.
Do not claim statistically balanced from 1 test run; tune after recorded data.
Avoid punitive report flow for ordinary permitted bluff/team gameplay.

manual: Moderated 4–8 player pilot; ensure multiple iterations before production.

tasks.rollback: Keep mode in private preview until balanced enough for agreed product goal.

tasks.title: Cross-mode privacy, authority, room/travel/reconnect regressions
acceptance: No secret card/role/target in spectator/metrics/chat reports.
Single table/account and RoomAuthority one-owner invariants preserved.
Interrupted matches recover or truthfully abort; no phantom wins/rewards.

manual: Review redacted snapshots, consent/capacity and prior world journeys.

tasks.rollback: Feature flags all OFF, revert only new Lodge registration, keep append-only outcome journal.

tasks.title: Observability và mixed-game load profile
deliverables: Recorded staged load profile and SLO hypothesis
acceptance: Metadata cardinality bounded by mode/status; no game IDs/role/secret in labels.
Report actual admitted tables/players and rejected commands, not only connected sockets.
No claim of 100+ tables or p95 target without actual hardware evidence.

manual: Run on isolated target host, record CPU/RAM/DB/WS with duration and cleanup.

tasks.rollback: Disable load runner/schedules; never run load against public production without explicit approval.

tasks.title: Admin world/game controls, metrics và incident kill switches
deliverables: Admin view mode status, live tables and queue metrics
acceptance: Single operator principal and existing MFA/audit boundaries apply.
Admin cannot inspect hidden hands/roles/targets in day-to-day metrics.
Disable blocks new start; in-flight match drain/abort policy tested and visibly explained.

manual: Operator drill for degraded/unknown data and on-duty reporting.

tasks.rollback: Restore previous reviewed feature flag via audited config, not direct DB edit.

tasks.title: Android single-device acceptance và release-independent proof
acceptance: Record model/OS/WebView/GPU and test coverage limit.
All three modes core flows and hidden-privacy work on available real Android.
Do not mark iOS/Windows/Steam Deck tested using Android evidence.

manual: Manual physical Android test with device log sanitization.

tasks.rollback: Disable mobile route/feature flag, no breaking server protocol rollback.

tasks.title: Staged internal playtest, no-go report và future Steam adapter scope
deliverables: Explicit web/Android/Steam readiness status per platform
acceptance: Art rights, security, moderation/ops and game acceptance are reviewed; all flags OFF until owner-controlled staging activation.
Staging candidate uses digest/ruleset/DB compatibility proof; public launch requires separate N12 release gates and explicit approvals.
Steam PC is future desktop adapter scope, not implied by a browser game; no false App Store/Play/Steam certification.

manual: Review pilot evidence and user fun feedback; owner decision logged as GO_INTERNAL / NO_GO.

tasks.rollback: Roll back desired digest/config by Git promotion where safe, keep migrations append-only, abort games truthfully.
